content: Microsoft Graph delegated access (auth-v2-user): OAuth2 authorization code flow with state for CSRF, offline_access for refresh tokens, redirect URI must match registration; access token short-lived (~1h), refresh token long-lived and rotated. Least-privilege delegated scopes: Files.Read[Write], Sites.Read[Write].All. Browse via /sites/{id}/drives and driveItem children; driveItem facets file/folder, eTag/cTag for concurrency, @microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior=fail|replace|rename (default PUT=replace), downloadUrl short-lived ~1h cannot be cached, versions list endpoint.
